cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(BTQParallelExecutionTest)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

# Find required packages
find_package(Threads REQUIRED)

# Include directories
include_directories(${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include)
include_directories(${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/build/_deps/concurrentqueue-src)
include_directories(${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include/threading)

# Add executable
add_executable(test_parallel_execution
    test_parallel_execution.cpp
    src/threading/task_scheduler.cpp
    src/threading/lockfree_queue.cpp
    include/threading/atomic_signal.hpp
)

# Link libraries
target_link_libraries(test_parallel_execution PRIVATE Threads::Threads)

# Compiler-specific options
if(MSVC)
    target_compile_options(test_parallel_execution PRIVATE /W4)
else()
    target_compile_options(test_parallel_execution PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -pedantic)
endif()

# Set output directory
set_target_properties(test_parallel_execution PROPERTIES
    RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}
)
